rule: Mobile CORE requires explicit mobile visual evidence, hierarchy preservation and purposeful mobile composition. Responsive existence alone is insufficient. M3 requires a live 390px capture plus human visual review; capture success alone is not M3.

evidence: Studio Design Award nominee page explicitly states mobile-first layout because mobile users are the majority.
The official renewal press release publishes a smartphone TOP-page image alongside the PC TOP-page image.

A first live 390px capture was held because the hero media did not render. A second capture with a longer wait rendered the intended people photograph, article card and editorial hierarchy at 390px while the 1440px state retained the broader discovery composition.

mobile_review.notes: Second live 390px capture passed visual review after the first unstable capture was rejected. Mobile preserves the emotional/editorial entry point, people photography, article action and brand grammar in a deliberately narrower sequence.

evidence: Studio Design Award nominee page explicitly states that the visual design explored how to express the verb 'かき混ぜる' and highlights the rotating-circle key visual.
ASI Design Gallery publishes separate PC, tablet and smartphone display captures for the IMA site.

Live 390px and 1440px captures were acquired from the current official site. The desktop state combines the brand verb with the circular IMA mark; the mobile state deliberately removes the side composition and concentrates the same brand verb into a single red field without horizontal overflow.

mobile_review.notes: Live 390px visual review passed. The Business Verb remains the dominant idea while desktop-only logo/circle complexity is intentionally reduced on mobile.

evidence: Web Grand Prix evidence supports the trust/accessibility and low-friction recruitment rationale.
ASI Design Gallery publishes separate PC, tablet and smartphone display captures for the SmartHR recruitment site.

Live 390px and 1440px captures were acquired from the current official recruiting site. The mobile state preserves the core headline, people imagery and brand grammar while reorganizing the desktop composition into a vertical reading sequence with menu access.

mobile_review.notes: Live 390px visual review passed. The message and people-first trust hierarchy survive while desktop navigation is compressed into a mobile navigation state.

evidence: Studio Design Award research supports the multi-business comprehension and people-focused rationale.
ASI Design Gallery publishes separate PC, tablet and smartphone display captures for the JMC recruitment site.

A live 390px capture preserved the headline but showed only a small fragment of the people imagery in the first viewport, so the people-trust hierarchy is not yet strong enough for strict M3 promotion.

mobile_review.notes: Live 390px evidence acquired, but strict M3 is HOLD because the initial viewport does not preserve enough of the people-led trust hierarchy. Keep M2 until a stronger verified mobile frame is captured or the intended responsive behavior is confirmed.

evidence: Studio Design Award 2025 selected the site among 50 nominees from more than 300 entries.
Studio Experts lists the recruiting site as a production work for the local recycling company.

Live 390px review preserves actual machinery/work photography, the 'Scrap Makes Future.' message, employment proof and industrial identity while recomposing the dense desktop collage into a narrow vertical poster.

mobile_review.notes: Strong LOCAL_SME_TRANSFER evidence. Mobile keeps real work, employer facts and the core industrial statement visible without collapsing the collage into generic cards.

evidence: The production case states that the site translates the company's friendly, sincere service and professional car-maintenance skill into illustration, red/blue brand color, signboard headings and traffic-light motifs.
ASI Design Gallery publishes PC, tablet and smartphone states.
Live 390px review preserves the mechanic character, car motifs, brand split, trust copy and immediate menu/contact actions while substantially reflowing the desktop scene.

mobile_review.notes: Strong local-service mobile benchmark: recognizable owner/service personality survives without stock photography, and conversion actions remain immediate.

evidence: Studio Design Award project notes describe on-site interviewing and photography intended to carry the employees' warmth and sincere attitude toward mushrooms into the site.
The production story describes an axis of human warmth, approachability and trust rather than detached food-brand polish.
Live 390px review preserves the real worker/mushroom image, mountain/region grammar, company promise and content entry while changing the desktop crop and navigation for mobile.

mobile_review.notes: Strong PHOTO/PERSON/MATERIAL benchmark for regional SMEs. Authentic company evidence remains the visual authority on mobile instead of being replaced by UI decoration.
